svg.title: Alien ring systems ☆ 異世界の環 — the mutually alien copies of ring theory in IUT

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif
'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: isekai no wa: "rings from other worlds", in inter-universal Teichmüller theory

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: Every Hodge theater of IUT lives in its own universe and carries its own copy of ring theory: number

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: fields, local fields K_v, and their + and ×. The links between Hodge theaters keep only part of that

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: structure, never the whole ring, so the copies are mutually alien. This page draws what that means,

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: with the numbers iut walk prints for abc(1,2400,2401) (l = 13).

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif
'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: i² = −1 maps the grid to itself

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: A ring has two operations welded together by the distributive law a(b+c) = ab + ac. On

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: Z[i] you can watch both: + slides the grid, × turns and stretches it, and the law makes

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: every slide agree with every turn. Mochizuki calls these the two combinatorial

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif
'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: IUT pulls the two dances apart, then asks how much of the ring survives.

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif
'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: A ring is a manzai duo: + is the boke, × is the tsukkomi, and the

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: distributive law is their timing. IUT books them into different Hodge

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif
'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif
'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: Don is +, ka is ×. A ring is a chart with both on every bar,

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: and a(b+c) = ab + ac is the full combo.

svg.text: Each Hodge theater has its own copy of ring theory. The Θ-link from †HT to ‡HT is an

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: isomorphism of multiplicative monoids that sends every theta value q̲^{j²}, j = 1…6, to the

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: one q̲. A ring map φ sends q̲^4 to φ(q̲)^4, so no ring map can do that: + has to stay home.

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: relaxed: q̲^36 and q̲ look like the same day to it.

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: needs a different setting for every j, which is exactly why it is not a ring map.

svg.text: The log-link goes one floor up the lattice, (n, m) → (n, m+1): the logarithm turns the units

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: O× of the lower Hodge theater into the additive group of the upper one. At ∞ you can

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: watch it: log unrolls C^× into a strip, circles become vertical lines and rays horizontal

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: ones, and the unit circle becomes the segment [−iπ, iπ]. The turn × e^{iπ/3} that moves

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: the blue cell to the pink one becomes the slide + iπ/3.

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: turns it back, but only near 1. The p-adic exp converges on a small disc only,

svg.text: Only data that can be rebuilt from the Galois group G_v crosses, and a group has no + and no ×. Kummer theory detaches the Frobenius-like monoids (the

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: ones with mass), the étale-like ghost (mass 0) crosses, and mono-anabelian geometry rebuilds K_v, ring and all, on the far side, up to Ind1 (Aut(G_v),

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: permutations), Ind2 (isomorphisms of O×μ) and Ind3 (upper semi-compatibility).

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: A ghost has no ring structure, which is why it is the one thing that can travel between alien rings.

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif
'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: A hologram concert: the projection data (G_v) goes on tour

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: and every venue rebuilds the singer on stage. Nobody asks which ring

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif
'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif
'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'DejaVu Sans', 'WenQuanYi Zen Hei', sans-serif

svg.text: shout "Release!" (re-attach). Out comes the same card, up to Ind1, Ind2 and

svg.text: disc of radius π; at v3, p* = 3 and I_v = p^{0}·O_v.
